name: Gated trigger in closed loop: the adopted G-CEM 3x filter acts only when its fork trigger fires AND the plan spreads the imagined futures more than holding (relative total variance), to cut the number of fixes
written: 2026-10-24 ~15:35, after fixcf (results/jenga/fixcf_result.json: one approach fix delays the grasp 1.36 chunks vs 0.41 removed; the time-out cost scales with the number of fixes) and the monitor replication (monrep PASS), and before any episode of this test
evidence_for_choice: eval/gate_trigger_check.py on policy-alone decisions (deep_dive/gate_trigger*.json). Rule AND_q = fork_3x AND tv_rel > the q-quantile of tv_rel on safe-episode decisions. q = 0.7 chosen on the two DEV sets (ocl, m3): safe alarm rate 12.0 -> 8.8% and 12.1 -> 9.3%, topples warned >= 3 chunks ahead 70.9 -> 69.1% and 76.7 -> 75.0%; scl (seen during the replication) 11.3 -> 8.4%, 79.2 -> 79.2%. Known risk: alarms in the last 3 chunks before a topple fall from ~58-61% to ~41-46%, so late fixes are lost. q = 0.8 cut more (to ~7.3%) but lost more late alarms (~33%); not chosen.
threshold: GATE_TV = 0.1065 = the 0.7-quantile of tv_rel over the pooled safe-episode decisions of the two dev sets (5436 decisions); fixed before this test

arms.cbfg3m: adopted filter: G-CEM, fork barrier (no fork up to 3x), OIL+ENS certificate, hold fallback
arms.cbfgtv3m: the same filter; the trigger additionally requires tv_rel = log tvar(plan) - log tvar(hold) > 0.1065, tvar = total variance of the 64 imagined HOLD30 latents at 4x the errors, computed from the trigger's own futures (the 4x scale is added to the trigger evaluation; h and o unchanged, checked exactly on 4 saved states). Certificate, cost, search and fallback unchanged. eval/cbf_filter.py CFG GATE_TV, mode cbfgtv3m

no_policy_arm: the policy-alone arm is omitted to save allocation (five 300-600 episode tests already compare cbfg3m with the policy)
settings: as stl (stress layouts, settled start, execution noise x2, HARD_OFF=1, per-episode seeds, 60 chunks max, model_OIL, WM_COMPILE=1, both arms of an episode in the same job), cluster/paired_array.sbatch
definitions: as stl: time-out = no neighbour topple, red block not extracted, no red fall before extraction; topple = logged_neighbour_toppled
primary: cbfgtv3m vs cbfg3m, paired by episode: (1) fewer time-outs, exact McNemar one-sided alpha 0.05; (2) neighbour topples non-inferior: one-sided 95% upper bound of the paired topple-rate difference (paired bootstrap, 10000, seed 20261024) <= +2 pp. Adopt the gate only if both pass.
secondary: v4 / v4b success, all failures, red falls, interventions per episode (expected about -25%), share of decisions gated
analysis: CL_TAG=gtv CL_ARMS='cbfg3m cbfgtv3m' python3 eval/steer_analysis.py on outcome_audit_gtv.json
stopping: none; all 600 episodes per arm; infrastructure failures re-run with the same settings; analysis on episodes complete in both arms
